title: Government knowledge that scalar waves alter radioisotope decay rates

tellings.quote: technology and the government's known for years that um you can actually affect the decay rate of radioisotopes by certain uh scalar electromagnetic waves.

plain: The US government has known for years that certain "scalar electromagnetic waves" can change how fast radioactive materials decay, according to Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies. He says this on the show without pointing to a record, but he credits the idea to the books of a writer named Tom Bearden, who uses that name for a special kind of electromagnetic wave. If it were true, it would mean the government quietly holds a way to change one of the steadiest processes in physics.
